results.description:
You didn't plan to become a carer. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to phone. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families looking after an elderly parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different towns.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a long-term condition.
Families caring alongside paid carers or a care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and carers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store GP letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbours or paid carers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgement or care you already give. It helps you organise it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organisational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kincarer.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Carer is a mobile app that enables people to take care of themselves and others conveniently. People with chronic illnesses and caregivers of the elderly can use the app to easily monitor and manage medical appointments and medications, receive relevant caregiving tips and support from an online community of healthcare professionals and caregivers, and easily hire qualified local nurses and trained caregivers for medical escort, home care and nursing procedures. 

Our Carers are registered local nurses and trained care aides who have the relevant skill certifications and eldercare experience. Our Carers have also passed stringent background checks.

Download the Carer app now to reduce your caregiving stress and burden, and take better care of yourself or your loved ones at home.

results.description:
What is Curam?
 
Curam is a home care app that enables you to easily find a carer local to you. Curam connects you to experienced self-employed carers and gives you the choice and control over who cares for you. On Curam you can book a carer easily, 24/7.
 
Curam Care Professionals can provide a wide range of care services, such as emergency care, live in care services, hourly care, autism care, dementia care, and much more.
 
All Care Professionals on Curam have been vetted through DBS, and bank level ID checks, plus an interview with our support team.
 
How Does Curam Work?
 
Care planning can be tricky, but not with Curam. Curam allows you to search for private carers near you using your postcode. Instantly explore the profiles of Care Professionals in your area and choose the best carer for your unique needs.
 
You can easily message Care Professionals and orgainse a video call through Curam’s in-app feature CuramMeet. Curam enables your family to stay connected through our FamilyCircle feature, giving family and friends the option to be kept updated with their loved one's care.
 
Post a job containing your care needs and Curam Care Professionals can apply directly to your job posting. You can then look through applicates’ profiles and message carers you think are suitable. Once you’ve found a Care Professional you’d like to hire, ask them to create a service agreement, and pay securely through the Curam Platform.
 
With Curam you can find and select the carer best suited to your care needs, quickly, easily and on your terms.
 
Curam Features Include:
 
Browse and message local Care Professionals
Real time availability checks
Transparent pricing- you only pay for the care you receive.
Care Professionals can negotiate rates.
Safe and secure booking
Safe and secure payments
Audio/Video calls
Hourly Care Service From Private Carers Near You
 
On Curam you can find hourly private homecare 24/7. Hourly care services are helpful for those who need some extra support, but don’t need care full-time. Hourly care can be organised for a couple of hours as and when you need it, or carers can be hired to visit on a daily or weekly basis, it’s up to you.
 
Live In Care Service And Overnight Support
 
Curam's app connects you to live-in Care Professionals when you need them. Live in carers will stay in your home offering round the clock care. Whether you're recovering from surgery, living with chronic health issues or long-term conditions, or simply want a helping hand to maintain your independence, Curam can connect you to experienced live in carers, plus with Curam, you get to select your live in companion.
 
Emergency Care You Can Book In Minutes
 
You can post a job in real time on Curam allowing you to connect to carers instantly. We’ve had users find, book and have a Curam Care Professional arrive all within 1 hour. This comes in handy when those in need of care are discharged from hospital at short notice, unexpected illnesses or there are unforeseen changes in family schedules.
 
Specialised And Complex Care Needs
 
Curam Care Professionals have an average of 10 years care experience and have a wide selection of care specialisms and experience. We have carers with experience in early and late-stage dementia, as well as autism care, post-operative care, children’s care, palliative care and much more. All carers on Curam have been fully vetted, DBS checked and interviewed, so you can have peace of mind when choosing your carer.
 
Plan Your Care With Confidence Using Our Home Care App
 
The Curam home care app allows you to view and message Care Professionals whenever you need care. You’re in control over who you pick to support you, simply message the carer you’d like and they’ll send a service agreement over and you can pay securely. The Curam app also allows you to video call carers and keep family up-to-date easily.
 
If you have any questions or feedback, please email us at client@curamcare.com

Ask Annie is an engaging education platform offering self-paced microlearning.

Annie guides learners through scenarios based on real-life experiences to strengthen their skills in delivering support to all clients, not only people living with dementia. The modules are short and focused on providing practical ways to address challenging situations.

Learners are given the flexibility to decide what and when to learn based on their time and needs, as well as the knowledge gaps identified through interactive quizzes. The search function helps to navigate through the application and find topics that learners want to explore. Ask Annie has been designed with the user in mind making learning a very engaging and intuitive experience.

Written in plain language and supported by the video content, this platform is suitable for staff from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.

The short modules have been written according to Dementia Australia’s own problem-solving model. The CAUSEd approach encourages staff to shift focus and understand how people living with dementia may be communicating their unmet needs through behaviors.
